target_profile.system_boundary: Captured OmniPaxos core, bundled memory/persistent storage and optional async actor runtime. The actor owns tick, notification and protocol dispatch; caller owns transport delivery and application state/new-configuration startup.
protocol_contexts: Configuration ID, ordered ballot, role/phase, per-follower sequence session, accepted and decided prefixes
external_interfaces: append, handle_incoming, take_outgoing_messages, tick, reconnected, read_decided_suffix, reconfigure, Storage

activities.purpose: Qualified support for decision formation and legal advancement
activities.realization_summary: Promise quorum selects history; matching Accepted quorum advances decision.

activities.purpose: Context validity and acquisition, transfer or loss of authority
activities.realization_summary: BLE proposes leadership; persisted promises, phase and sequence checks constrain work.

activities.purpose: Recovery and resynchronization of eligible participation
activities.realization_summary: Stored promise and reconnect enter recovery, with PrepareReq/Prepare/Promise/AcceptSync handshake.
Validated cluster settings determine peers and shared quorum; configured peer conversion excludes local PID. StopSign identifies next cluster, which caller starts.
Internal reads classify entries below the decided boundary. Actor can return suffixes or fan them to subscribers; application remains caller-owned.

activities.purpose: History, persistence and reconstruction of support
activities.realization_summary: Construction reconstructs cached indices, rounds and StopSign from Storage. MemoryStorage retains values in-process; PersistentStorage reopens RocksDB keys and writes synchronization operations in a WriteBatch. Storage promises rollback on returned errors; detailed failure testing remains open.

activities.purpose: Client contracts, invocation intervals and observed completion
activities.realization_summary: Synchronous append admits a proposal. Optional actor tags append_notify calls, records placement, polls decision completion on tick and exposes read/subscription APIs; transport still belongs to caller.

behaviors.protocol_context: Configuration-local ordered ballot and prepare phase
behaviors.trigger: A newer local election or incoming Prepare
implementation_guards: Local election must exceed leader ballot and storage promise; follower accepts higher promise or equal promise in Recover.
writes: New local leader resets LeaderState, flushes batches, persists promise, records own promise and enters Prepare. Follower flushes batches, persists promise, enters Prepare and resets sequence number.
external_effects: Local leader queues Prepare to peers; follower queues and caches Promise carrying prior accepted round and indices with conditional log suffix.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Prepare gathers prior accepted histories to constrain the next leader log.

behaviors.protocol_context: One leader ballot, Prepare then Accept
behaviors.trigger: Matching Promise, local proposal or Accepted
implementation_guards: Promises counted per sender slot; preparation requires configured quorum. Accepted is consumed only in Leader/Accept with matching ballot.
writes: On prepare quorum choose maximum prior accepted history, sync storage with maximum reported decided index, append buffered proposals unless stopped, record own accepted index, enter Accept.
Accepted overwrites sender index; is_chosen counts indexes at least the reported index; qualifying new index updates decided index.
external_effects: Queue AcceptSync for promised followers, AcceptDecide for proposals, and Decide or piggyback decision after quorum.
async_boundaries: Outgoing messages require caller extraction and delivery; append return is proposal admission, not decision.

cross_activity_effects.A2: Only matching-ballot replies advance this leader; a new leader initializes fresh accounting.
cross_activity_effects.A5: Decision index is propagated for later application reads.

implementation_guards: AcceptSync requires equal promise and Follower/Prepare. AcceptDecide and StopSign require Follower/Accept plus expected sequence; Decide requires Accept phase plus expected sequence.
writes: AcceptSync synchronizes history then enters Accept and installs sequence. Ordered accepts append; decided-index update may flush batching and caps new decision by available accepted index in that branch.
external_effects: Accepted replies are queued or coalesced after completed storage calls; synchronization forwards buffered proposals if no StopSign.

cross_activity_effects.A2: Stale ballot is rejected with NotAccepted; unexpected higher ballot requests recovery.

behaviors.execution_owner: SequencePaxos construction, reconnect and retry handlers
behaviors.trigger: Stored promise at construction, reconnected callback, sequence gap or resend timeout
writes: Stored promise starts Recover; reconnect to current leader enters Recover; leader PrepareReq resets sender promise and latest accept metadata.
external_effects: PrepareReq prompts Prepare; follower retries cached Promise or recovery PrepareReq. Leader retries Prepare and StopSign/StopSign decision as appropriate.

cross_activity_effects.A2: Equal-ballot Prepare is re-admitted in Recover.
cross_activity_effects.A1: Recovery establishes synchronized log before accepting subsequent ordered work.

implementation_guards: Heartbeat reply checks round and ballot configuration ID.
writes: Replies are appended to a vector; happiness counts potential followers, using write quorum in Leader/Accept and read quorum otherwise; unhappy quorum-connected node increments ballot.
external_effects: Queue heartbeat messages; timeout can select local ballot for SequencePaxos.

cross_activity_effects.A1: BLE selection still requires SequencePaxos prepare promises before formation.

behaviors.protocol_context: Accepted round, decided prefix, optional suffix/snapshot/StopSign
behaviors.trigger: Leader prepare quorum or follower AcceptSync
writes: Updates cache and issues write_atomically with round/decision plus optional trim, snapshot, prefix replacement and StopSign operations.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Installs history used for subsequent accepted acknowledgments.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Associates installed history with accepted ballot.

behaviors.protocol_context: Fixed cluster node list and configuration ID
implementation_guards: Validate cluster and server settings; require local PID in configured node list.
writes: Peers are configured nodes excluding own PID; shared flexible quorum passed to both components; BLE receives configuration ID and recovered promise.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Member count determines promise and accept quorum thresholds.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Build seeds BLE with stored promise and initializes SequencePaxos recovery.

behaviors.protocol_context: Stored promise, accepted round, decided/compacted index and StopSign
writes: Cache loads promise and accepted round, decision and compacted index, StopSign; accepted index equals stored log length plus compacted prefix plus StopSign presence.
existing_protections: Storage trait requires atomic ordered operations with rollback on Err. PersistentStorage batches sync operations into one RocksDB write; MemoryStorage uses infallible in-memory updates under ordinary valid indices.

cross_activity_effects.A2: Reloaded promise constrains future prepares and accepts.
cross_activity_effects.A1: Recovered accepted history and decisions inform future promises.

behaviors.protocol_context: Current actor-owned or synchronous storage state
implementation_guards: Suffix ends at current decided index; lower reads classify entries by absolute log index relative to decision boundary.
external_effects: Returns Decided entries, compacted-prefix marker, and/or StopSign status; no application state mutation.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Exposes the decided prefix rather than treating append admission as agreement.

behaviors.execution_owner: ActorState pending, append_tracked, reconcile_unconfirmed and Assigned handler
behaviors.protocol_context: EntryId-scoped pending call, assigned index and ballot
behaviors.trigger: AppendNotify admission; local stable-leader append, batch reconciliation or incoming Assigned
implementation_guards: Stable leader (local pid and Accept phase) required for tracked leader acceptance; pending admission limited; record_assignment matches EntryId.
Batch reconciliation discards tracking on ballot mismatch.
writes: Allocate EntryId; retain entry until dispatch. Immediate append records accepted_after and current promise; deferred batch queues tracking intent. Remote Assigned overwrites matching pending assignment.
external_effects: Route TaggedProposal to leader and Assigned back to origin.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Assignment records acceptance position, not a quorum decision.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Records ballot at assignment but incoming Assigned has no current-ballot filter.

behaviors.protocol_context: Pending call assignment and current local decided index/promise
behaviors.trigger: Tick after core tick, event emission, dispatch and reconciliation
reads: Pending assigned index/ballot, current decided index and promise, wall-clock deadline
important_branches: If assigned idx <= decided, send Ok(idx), without testing ballot. Otherwise if assignment ballot < current promise, send Superseded; otherwise expired deadline sends Timeout; remaining calls stay pending.
external_effects: Oneshot completes the original append_notify future.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Interprets local decided boundary as completion of the identified proposal.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Checks supersession only after the success branch.

behaviors.protocol_context: Single actor owns OmniPaxos state, separate incoming/command queues and periodic timers
behaviors.trigger: Executor poll, incoming message, command or timer
writes: Serializes access; dispatches AsyncRuntime control messages separately from core protocol.
external_effects: Tick drives core, awaits event sends, dispatches pending work, reconciles assignments, drains notifiers and pushes subscriber data. Egress drains core messages into bounded outgoing transport channel.
handle_incoming enqueues a message; read commands obtain state after their own dispatch. Handle drop closes channels and ends actor when a receive stream closes.
async_boundaries: Multiple incoming messages may run between ticks; incoming handling does not itself call drain_notifiers. Event sends can await channel capacity. External transport owns routing/delivery and reconnect notification.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Drives ticks and transports protocol output, including bounded-buffer dropping of oldest messages.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Dispatches actual core Prepare and AcceptSync transitions before later notification ticks.

facts.meaning: The replica records its current promised ballot; acceptance handlers compare message ballot to this value. This alone is not evidence of a prepare or accept quorum.
facts.validity_context: Current instance storage promise, updated by leadership acquisition and admitted Prepare; recover phase permits equal-ballot re-preparation.
facts.durability: Written through storage before Promise or local Prepare progression; actual backend crash guarantees remain unread.
facts.recovery: Constructor reads stored promise and enters Recover, issuing PrepareReq.
unknowns: PersistentStorage power-loss durability and failure rollback details remain untested; MemoryStorage has no process-crash durability.

facts.meaning: An identified pending append has a recorded assigned log index and assignment ballot, produced by a local accepted append/batch or a received Assigned message. It asserts recorded placement in that context, not decision or preservation of entry identity under later ballots.
facts.validity_context: Pending object until completion, failure or actor shutdown. An assignment can survive core ballot changes between notifier ticks and may be overwritten by another matching Assigned.
facts.durability: Volatile actor bookkeeping, not part of the replicated log or Storage.
facts.recovery: No pending-call reconstruction on actor restart; channel closure returns Shutdown through handle.
unknowns: Whether success after ballot change can refer to a different decided entry under one legal message history.

surfaces.reason: Vector includes slots up to max PID; determine permitted membership identity shape and compaction contract.
Round/configuration filtering does not deduplicate replies; transport duplication legality and consequences need source investigation.
Retry branches distinguish protocol messages; caller reconnect and delivery duties remain to establish.
Actor dispatches runtime wire messages before the core; tick performs notification. Caller still owns transport.
Cursor advances per returned LogEntry, while compacted prefix markers represent multiple indices; inspect snapshot subscription history and contract.

formation.explanation: Append is proposal admission: followers forward or buffer, leaders buffer in Prepare or append in Accept. A new leader gathers sender-indexed promises, selects the maximum accepted history and maximum reported decision index, synchronizes storage, then sends AcceptSync. Followers acknowledge synchronized or appended log indices. The leader counts per-sender accepted indices for its ballot and advances decisions when the configured write quorum supports an index. Decide/AcceptDecide propagate the index; public reads distinguish Decided from Undecided and applications consume the former. InternalStorage read classifies values below the decided index; the actor has a separate proposal-identity assignment and completion layer, so correct decided-index advancement alone does not establish correct append_notify completion.

context.explanation: BLE uses heartbeat rounds and configuration-tagged ballots to select leadership. SequencePaxos independently requires a ballot higher than its existing leader and promise. A local leader resets volatile quorum accounting and persists its promise; a receiving follower persists a higher promise and enters Prepare. Accept processing requires the promised ballot and appropriate phase, and ordered messages use session/counter sequence numbers. Older requests are rejected or ignored; higher unexpected accepts and sequence gaps initiate recovery. Persisted promises start recovery after reconstruction. NotAccepted marks a peer as having promised higher. Build derives peers from configuration, passes quorum policy to both core components, reloads stored promise into BLE and reconstructs cached log metadata. The actor serializes protocol dispatch but can dispatch multiple incoming messages between ticks.

connection.explanation: Authority is insufficient without prepare support: prior accepted rounds and lengths determine the history installed in the new ballot, while prior decisions constrain the reported decision prefix. Buffered proposals are incorporated after history selection unless a StopSign is present; follower synchronization forwards buffered proposals if not stopped. Old-ballot acknowledgments cannot advance a new leader because accepted handlers require matching ballots and leader state is reset. Recovery reuses equal-ballot Prepare only in Recover and starts a new accept sequence session. StopSign travels with synchronized history and stops new local admission; starting the next configuration and carrying application history is a documented caller duty. Storage reconstruction supplies prior promise/history; runtime notification bookkeeping remains volatile and separate. Assigned position is consumed with a later decided-boundary read; its ballot is checked only after the success branch, leaving entry identity across replacement as a specific question.

open_details: Sparse node IDs: accepted_indexes is sized by maximum PID, and minimum-all includes every slot; applicability of sparse IDs and trim semantics unresolved.
BLE counts reply vector entries, unlike sender-indexed promises; duplicate delivery contract and any runtime protection unresolved.
Ordinary AcceptDecide/Accepted/Decide are absent from periodic resend branches; inspect transport/reconnect contract and later continuation triggers before inferring progress duty.
Pending assignment identity versus decided slot after leader replacement; existing Superseded path runs only when success condition did not match.
Actor subscriber cursor treats returned vector positions as log positions; compacted prefix markers can cover multiple indices.
PersistentStorage serialization/error rollback and crash durability remain deeper fault-contract questions.
core_overview.rationale: Both core paths and their ownership/reconstruction/consumption connection are traced through caller interfaces, actor dispatch and storage. Open local anomalies and backend fault details are not treated as proven protections.
